categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds CMake integration via CMakeLists.txt and updates CI scripts to test running functional tests via CTest.
categories.rationale: Enables opt-in CTest scheduling and reporting for functional tests within the CMake build system and CI. As noted in the description, this allows developers to schedule tests together and upload per-test results to CDash, though it remains an optional workflow enhancement requiring CMake 4.4+.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and updates test_runner.py to support direct CTest discovery and execution.
categories.rationale: Extends test framework capabilities by adding direct CTest execution modes and concurrent temp directory handling. As stated in the description, this allows 'scheduling unit and functional tests together' and reporting granular metrics to dashboards.
